name: Nar Haaska
description: Nar Haaska was a Hutt Space trade world. It was a part of the territory controlled by the Hutts by 25,000 BBY, and by 17 BBY, the world became a part of the Galactic Empire. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Nar Haaska system.
lead_paragraphs: Nar Haaska was a Hutt Space trade world. It was a part of the territory controlled by the Hutts by 25,000 BBY, and by 17 BBY, the world became a part of the Galactic Empire. During the Yuuzhan Vong War, the extra-galactic Yuuzhan Vong conquered the Nar Haaska system.
